title: Adaptive clearing lives in the Adaptive operations only: drop the Adaptive strategy from 2D Pocket, add a Method choice

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
Decided by the maintainer (2026-11-13). His question in chat: "Should we have "both" 2D pocket with the strategy of adaptive making one type of path - and 2D Adaptive ... both might have its purpose - but its confusing to the user which does what.. Trochoidal should land on 2D and 3D Adaptives to start with tho (see issues)". Answer in the question dialog: "Adaptive op only".

What is confusing today: 2D Pocket offers an Adaptive strategy (`PocketStrategy` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_strategy.rs`) and there is also a separate 2D Adaptive operation. Both run the same adaptive planner, so two places make the same kind of cut with different pages.

Wanted:
- 2D Pocket keeps Zigzag and Waterline only (classic offset pocketing). The Adaptive entry leaves its strategy list.
- All constant-load clearing lives in 2D Adaptive, which gets a Method choice: Spiral/HSM (today's path) or Trochoidal (issue 1509). 3D Adaptive gets the same Method choice.
- A project saved with 2D Pocket + Adaptive opens as a 2D Adaptive operation with the same parameters and generates the same toolpath (no silent change of what is cut). If a parameter cannot be carried, the operation opens marked "needs review" and names it; it never posts a different path without saying so.
- The MCP tools and script verbs follow: the Pocket strategy value is refused by name with a pointer to 2D Adaptive, or mapped the same way as the project file.

Rules: one planner, one home per kind of cut; a project-file change that older builds cannot read is a breaking change and says so.

Done means: Pocket's strategy list has no Adaptive; an old project with Pocket+Adaptive reopens as 2D Adaptive with an identical golden CL; 2D and 3D Adaptive show a Method choice (Trochoidal may land with issue 1509); undo/redo; MCP parameters; structural UI test updated.

Related: 1509 (trochoidal method in 2D Adaptive), 1503, 220, 1512 (stepover / engagement / optimal load).
